definition_en: used when choosing the best-supported cause or answer
definition_es: se usa para elegir la causa o respuesta mejor sustentada
example_en: Which condition is most likely to cause the malfunction?

definition_en: the action that must occur before the other listed actions
definition_es: la acción que debe ocurrir antes que las demás
example_en: What should the electrician do first?

definition_es: antes de una acción o evento
example_en: Verify isolation prior to servicing the equipment.

definition_en: in conformity with a stated source or requirement
definition_es: de conformidad con una fuente o requisito
example_en: Test the device according to the manufacturer’s specifications.

definition_en: confirm that a condition or result is correct
definition_es: confirmar que una condición o resultado es correcto
example_en: Verify operation after the repair.

definition_en: establish a result through inspection, calculation or testing
definition_es: establecer un resultado mediante inspección, cálculo o prueba
example_en: Determine the source of the malfunction.

definition_en: recognize and correctly name or locate something
definition_es: reconocer y nombrar o localizar correctamente algo
example_en: Identify the isolation point on the single-line diagram.

definition_en: a condition in which equipment does not operate as intended
definition_es: condición en la que el equipo no opera como se espera
example_en: Obtain a detailed description of the malfunction.

definition_en: an on-site assessment used in troubleshooting or maintenance
definition_es: evaluación en sitio usada para diagnóstico o mantenimiento
example_en: Compare the field assessment with diagnostic test results.

definition_en: test instruments used to find and evaluate faults
definition_es: instrumentos usados para localizar y evaluar fallas
example_en: Use diagnostic test equipment to determine the source of the fault.

definition_en: activities that verify a system is ready to operate as intended
definition_es: actividades que verifican que un sistema está listo para operar
example_en: Document commissioning test results.

definition_en: activities used to safely remove a system from service
definition_es: actividades para retirar un sistema de servicio de forma segura
example_en: Follow the facility procedure when decommissioning equipment.

definition_en: a drawing updated to reflect the installed condition
definition_es: plano actualizado para reflejar la condición instalada
example_en: Update the as-built drawing after the change.

definition_en: technical requirements supplied by the equipment manufacturer
definition_es: requisitos técnicos proporcionados por el fabricante
example_en: Test the repaired starter to the manufacturer’s specifications.

definition_en: planned timing and scope of maintenance tasks
definition_es: planificación de tiempos y alcance del mantenimiento
example_en: Record test results in the maintenance schedule.

definition_en: a component selected to replace a defective or damaged part
definition_es: componente seleccionado para sustituir una pieza defectuosa
example_en: Select an OEM or equivalent replacement component.

definition_en: performing work while minimizing interruption to operations
definition_es: realizar el trabajo minimizando la interrupción de operaciones
example_en: Replace the component with minimal disruption to the process.

definition_en: the measured or observed outcome of a test
definition_es: resultado medido u observado de una prueba
example_en: Compare the test result with previous records.

definition_en: a pattern in measured values over time
definition_es: patrón de valores medidos a través del tiempo
example_en: Analyze the input signal trend to verify signal integrity.

definition_en: the condition of being complete, reliable and fit for intended operation
definition_es: condición de ser completo, confiable y apto para operar
example_en: Verify the integrity of the analog signal.
